cycles.otto_cycle.title: Otto cycle thermal efficiency
assumptions: Air-standard Otto cycle: reversible adiabatic compression/expansion, constant-volume heat addition/rejection, constant cp and cv. Efficiency depends only on r and γ.

cycles.otto_mep.title: Air-standard Otto cycle: states, work, efficiency and mean effective pressure

variables.name: R
variables.desc: specific gas constant of the working fluid

variables.name: q_in
variables.desc: heat added per unit mass (constant volume)

procedure.python:
def _otto_full(values):
    """Air-standard Otto cycle per unit mass of working fluid (constant cv, cp).

    States: 1 BDC before compression, 2 TDC after isentropic compression, 3 after constant-volume heat
    addition q_in, 4 after isentropic expansion back to V1. Returns temperatures (K), pressures (Pa),
    net work (J/kg), thermal efficiency and mean effective pressure (Pa).
    """
    P1, T1, r = values['P1'], values['T1'], values['r']
    gamma, R = values['gamma'], values['R']
    q_in = values['q_in']
    cv = R / (gamma - 1.0)
    if r <= 1.0:
        raise MechError('r: compression ratio must be > 1')
    v1 = R * T1 / P1
    v2 = v1 / r
    T2 = T1 * r ** (gamma - 1.0)
    P2 = P1 * r ** gamma
    T3 = T2 + q_in / cv
    P3 = P2 * T3 / T2
    T4 = T3 / r ** (gamma - 1.0)
    P4 = P3 / r ** gamma
    q_out = cv * (T4 - T1)
    w_net = q_in - q_out
    eta = w_net / q_in
    mep = w_net / (v1 - v2)
    return {'T2': T2, 'T3': T3, 'T4': T4, 'P2': P2, 'P3': P3, 'P4': P4,
            'q_out': q_out, 'w_net': w_net, 'eta': eta, 'mep': mep}

assumptions: Air standard (ideal gas, constant cp/cv), reversible adiabatic compression/expansion, constant-volume heat addition. MEP = W_net/(V1 − V2) with V1 = R T1 / P1 per unit mass.

cycles.diesel_cycle.title: Diesel cycle thermal efficiency
assumptions: Air-standard Diesel cycle: constant-pressure heat addition (cutoff ratio r_c), reversible adiabatic compression/expansion. r_c = 1 recovers the Otto efficiency, but the closed form is singular there (r_c must exceed 1; use otto_cycle for r_c = 1).

cycles.dual_cycle.title: Dual (limited-pressure) cycle thermal efficiency

variables.name: r_p
variables.desc: pressure ratio P3/P2 during constant-volume heat addition
variables.label: rp

assumptions: Air-standard dual cycle: constant-volume then constant-pressure heat addition. r_p = 1 gives the Diesel cycle; r_c = 1 gives the Otto cycle.

cycles.brayton_cycle.title: Brayton (gas-turbine) cycle thermal efficiency
assumptions: Air-standard Brayton cycle: isentropic compressor/turbine, constant-pressure heat addition/rejection, constant cp/cv. Efficiency depends only on rp and γ.

cycles.brayton_bwr.title: Brayton cycle back work ratio
assumptions: Ideal (isentropic) compressor and turbine with equal mass flow and specific heat, so bwr = cp(T2 − T1) / cp(T3 − T4) cancels cp.
method_references: Back work ratio of the air-standard Brayton cycle

cycles.regenerator_effectiveness.title: Regenerator effectiveness (gas-turbine recuperation)

variables.name: T5
variables.desc: air temperature leaving the regenerator (into combustor)

variables.name: T2
variables.desc: air temperature leaving the compressor (into regenerator)

variables.name: T4
variables.desc: exhaust temperature leaving the turbine (into regenerator)

assumptions: Effectiveness is the actual air temperature rise divided by the maximum possible rise (to the turbine-exhaust temperature). ε = 1 is the ideal regenerator.

cycles.intercooler_optimum.title: Optimum intermediate pressure for two-stage compression with intercooling
assumptions: Two ideal-gas stages with perfect intercooling to the inlet temperature; equal pressure ratios across the stages minimise the total compression work.
method_references: Minimum-work split for multistage compression with intercooling, P2 = √(P1 P3) (recalled)

cycles.reheat_turbine.title: Two-stage gas turbine with reheat

variables.name: cp
variables.desc: constant-pressure specific heat of the gas

variables.name: w_single
variables.desc: work of one turbine without reheat

procedure.python:
def _reheat_turbine(values):
    """Two-stage ideal-gas turbine with reheat to T_max between the stages.

    a = (γ−1)/γ; T2s = T_max (P_int/P1)^a is the exit of stage 1, T4s = T_max (P2/P_int)^a of stage 2
    (both reheated to T_max at entry). w_single is the work of one turbine expanding P1 → P2 with no
    reheat, so w_extra is the work gained by reheating. Equal stage pressure ratios (P_int = sqrt(P1 P2))
    maximise w_two for a given T_max.
    """
    T_max, P1, P2, P_int = values['T_max'], values['P1'], values['P2'], values['P_int']
    gamma, cp = values['gamma'], values['cp']
    if not P1 > P_int > P2:
        raise MechError('need P1 > P_int > P2 (intermediate pressure between high and low)')
    a = (gamma - 1.0) / gamma
    T2s = T_max * (P_int / P1) ** a
    T4s = T_max * (P2 / P_int) ** a
    w_stage1 = cp * (T_max - T2s)
    w_stage2 = cp * (T_max - T4s)
    w_two = w_stage1 + w_stage2
    w_single = cp * T_max * (1.0 - (P2 / P1) ** a)
    return {'T2s': T2s, 'T4s': T4s, 'w_stage1': w_stage1, 'w_stage2': w_stage2,
            'w_two': w_two, 'w_single': w_single, 'w_extra': w_two - w_single}

assumptions: Ideal gas, isentropic stages, reheating restores the gas to T_max between stages. Equal stage pressure ratios (P_int = √(P1 P2)) maximise the reheat work for a given T_max.
method_references: Isentropic turbine-stage work; reheat work gain (recalled)

cycles.jet_thrust.title: Jet engine thrust (momentum + pressure term)

variables.name: F
variables.desc: net thrust (negative when V_e < V_in, e.g. a deployed reverser)

variables.name: m_dot
variables.desc: mass flow rate of air (and fuel) through the engine

variables.name: V_e
variables.desc: exit (jet) velocity relative to the engine

assumptions: Steady one-dimensional flow; fuel mass flow included in m_dot. For a matched nozzle (P_e = P_amb) only the momentum term remains. Static takeoff: V_in = 0.
method_references: Momentum equation for jet thrust, F = ṁ(V_e − V_in) + (P_e − P_a)A_e

cycles.rankine_cycle.title: Rankine cycle: states, work, heat and efficiency

variables.name: T_boiler
variables.desc: turbine-inlet temperature (≥ T_sat(P_boiler); equal to T_sat gives saturated vapour)

procedure.python:
def _rankine(values):
    """Ideal (or actual) Rankine cycle from CoolProp state points.

    States: 1 saturated liquid at P_cond, 2 pump outlet (h2 = h1 + v1 ΔP / η_pump), 3 turbine inlet —
    saturated vapour at P_boiler when T_boiler ≈ T_sat(P_boiler), otherwise superheated to T_boiler —,
    4 turbine outlet (h4 = h3 − η_turb (h3 − h4s), h4s at P_cond with s = s3). Returns the state
    enthalpies, quality at the turbine outlet, works, heats, and thermal efficiency.
    """
    fluid = values['fluid']
    P_cond, P_boiler = values['P_cond'], values['P_boiler']
    T_boiler, eta_turb, eta_pump = values['T_boiler'], values['eta_turb'], values['eta_pump']
    if not P_boiler > P_cond:
        raise MechError('P_boiler must exceed P_cond')
    sat_c = common.saturation(fluid, P=P_cond)
    h1 = sat_c['liquid']['h']
    v1 = 1.0 / sat_c['liquid']['rho']
    T_cond = sat_c['T']
    h3, s3, T_sat_b = _turbine_inlet(fluid, P_boiler, T_boiler)
    w_pump = v1 * (P_boiler - P_cond) / eta_pump
    h2 = h1 + w_pump
    h4s = common.fluid_state(fluid, P=P_cond, s=s3)['h']
    w_turb = eta_turb * (h3 - h4s)
    h4 = h3 - w_turb
    hf, hg = sat_c['liquid']['h'], sat_c['vapour']['h']
    x4 = (h4 - hf) / (hg - hf)
    q_in = h3 - h2
    q_out = h4 - h1
    w_net = w_turb - w_pump
    eta = w_net / q_in
    return {'T_cond': T_cond, 'T_sat_boiler': T_sat_b, 'h1': h1, 'h2': h2, 'h3': h3, 'h4': h4,
            'x4': x4, 'w_pump': w_pump, 'w_turb': w_turb, 'w_net': w_net,
            'q_in': q_in, 'q_out': q_out, 'eta': eta}

assumptions: Steam properties from CoolProp (IAPWS-95). Ideal pump work uses the saturated-liquid specific volume (incompressible). x4 > 1 means the turbine exit is still superheated.
method_references: Rankine cycle energy balances on pump, boiler, turbine and condenser (recalled)

cycles.rankine_reheat.title: Reheat Rankine cycle

variables.name: T_boiler
variables.desc: HP turbine inlet temperature (≥ T_sat; equal to T_sat gives saturated vapour)

variables.name: x6
variables.desc: steam quality at LP turbine outlet

procedure.python:
def _rankine_reheat(values):
    """Reheat Rankine cycle.

    1 sat. liquid at P_cond → 2 pump to P_boiler → 3 superheat to T_boiler at P_boiler → 4 HP turbine to
    P_reheat (s constant) → 5 reheat to T_reheat at P_reheat → 6 LP turbine to P_cond → 1. The HP/LP
    turbines share one isentropic efficiency η_turb; the pump uses η_pump. Returns enthalpy at every
    state, works, heats, LP-turbine-exit quality x6, and thermal efficiency.
    """
    fluid = values['fluid']
    P_cond, P_boiler, P_reheat = values['P_cond'], values['P_boiler'], values['P_reheat']
    T_boiler, T_reheat = values['T_boiler'], values['T_reheat']
    eta_turb, eta_pump = values['eta_turb'], values['eta_pump']
    if not P_boiler > P_reheat > P_cond:
        raise MechError('need P_boiler > P_reheat > P_cond')
    sat_c = common.saturation(fluid, P=P_cond)
    h1 = sat_c['liquid']['h']
    v1 = 1.0 / sat_c['liquid']['rho']
    sat_r = common.saturation(fluid, P=P_reheat)
    if T_reheat < sat_r['T'] - 1e-3 * sat_r['T']:
        raise MechError(f'reheat temperature {T_reheat:.3g} K is below the saturation temperature '
                        f'{sat_r["T"]:.3g} K at P_reheat; reheat must be saturated vapour or superheated')
    h3, s3, _ = _turbine_inlet(fluid, P_boiler, T_boiler)
    w_pump = v1 * (P_boiler - P_cond) / eta_pump
    h2 = h1 + w_pump
    h4s = common.fluid_state(fluid, P=P_reheat, s=s3)['h']
    h4 = h3 - eta_turb * (h3 - h4s)
    st5 = common.fluid_state(fluid, P=P_reheat, T=T_reheat)
    h5, s5 = st5['h'], st5['s']
    h6s = common.fluid_state(fluid, P=P_cond, s=s5)['h']
    h6 = h5 - eta_turb * (h5 - h6s)
    hf, hg = sat_c['liquid']['h'], sat_c['vapour']['h']
    x6 = (h6 - hf) / (hg - hf)
    w_turb = (h3 - h4) + (h5 - h6)
    q_in = (h3 - h2) + (h5 - h4)
    w_net = w_turb - w_pump
    eta = w_net / q_in
    return {'h1': h1, 'h2': h2, 'h3': h3, 'h4': h4, 'h5': h5, 'h6': h6, 'x6': x6,
            'w_pump': w_pump, 'w_turb': w_turb, 'w_net': w_net, 'q_in': q_in, 'eta': eta}

assumptions: Steam properties from CoolProp (IAPWS-95). One turbine efficiency for both stages. Reheat raises the average heat-addition temperature and reduces exhaust moisture.

cycles.rankine_regenerative.title: Regenerative Rankine cycle with one open feedwater heater

variables.name: T_boiler
variables.desc: turbine-inlet temperature (≥ T_sat; equal to T_sat gives saturated vapour)

procedure.python:
def _rankine_regenerative(values):
    """Regenerative Rankine with one open feedwater heater (OFWH).

    1 sat. liquid at P_cond → 2 pump I to P_fwh → mixed with extraction flow y at P_fwh → 3 sat. liquid at
    P_fwh → 4 pump II to P_boiler → 5 turbine inlet (sat. vapour at P_boiler or superheated to T_boiler) →
    6 extraction at P_fwh, 7 turbine exit at P_cond. The extraction mass fraction y follows from the OFWH
    energy balance y h6 + (1−y) h2 = h3. The turbine isentropic efficiency η_turb is applied to both
    stages: h6 = h5 − η_turb(h5 − h6s), s6 = s(P_fwh, h6), then h7 = h6 − η_turb(h6 − h7s) with
    h7s = h(P_cond, s6). Works are per unit mass through the boiler/turbine.
    """
    fluid = values['fluid']
    P_cond, P_fwh, P_boiler = values['P_cond'], values['P_fwh'], values['P_boiler']
    T_boiler, eta_turb, eta_pump = values['T_boiler'], values['eta_turb'], values['eta_pump']
    if not P_boiler > P_fwh > P_cond:
        raise MechError('need P_boiler > P_fwh > P_cond')
    sat_c = common.saturation(fluid, P=P_cond)
    h1 = sat_c['liquid']['h']
    v1 = 1.0 / sat_c['liquid']['rho']
    sat_f = common.saturation(fluid, P=P_fwh)
    h3 = sat_f['liquid']['h']
    v3 = 1.0 / sat_f['liquid']['rho']
    h5, s5, _ = _turbine_inlet(fluid, P_boiler, T_boiler)
    # pump I (1 -> 2, per kg through the condenser), pump II (3 -> 4, per kg through the boiler)
    h2 = h1 + v1 * (P_fwh - P_cond) / eta_pump
    h4 = h3 + v3 * (P_boiler - P_fwh) / eta_pump
    # extraction (5 -> 6) at P_fwh and LP stage (6 -> 7) at P_cond, both with the turbine efficiency.
    h6s = common.fluid_state(fluid, P=P_fwh, s=s5)['h']
    h6 = h5 - eta_turb * (h5 - h6s)
    s6 = common.fluid_state(fluid, P=P_fwh, h=h6)['s']
    h7s = common.fluid_state(fluid, P=P_cond, s=s6)['h']
    h7 = h6 - eta_turb * (h6 - h7s)
    if not h6 > h2:
        raise MechError('extraction enthalpy is not above the feedwater enthalpy; check pressures')
    y = (h3 - h2) / (h6 - h2)
    w_p1 = (1.0 - y) * v1 * (P_fwh - P_cond) / eta_pump
    w_p2 = v3 * (P_boiler - P_fwh) / eta_pump
    w_turb = (h5 - h6) + (1.0 - y) * (h6 - h7)
    q_in = h5 - h4
    w_net = w_turb - w_p1 - w_p2
    eta = w_net / q_in
    return {'y': y, 'h1': h1, 'h2': h2, 'h3': h3, 'h4': h4, 'h5': h5, 'h6': h6, 'h7': h7,
            'w_pump': w_p1 + w_p2, 'w_turb': w_turb, 'w_net': w_net, 'q_in': q_in, 'eta': eta}

assumptions: One open (mixing) feedwater heater; y solves y h6 + (1−y) h2 = h3. Works are per unit mass through the boiler/turbine; the condenser flow is (1 − y).
method_references: Open-feedwater-heater energy balance for regenerative Rankine (recalled)

cycles.combined_cycle.title: Combined gas-steam cycle efficiency
assumptions: The bottoming cycle recovers the topping-cycle exhaust, so its heat input is the fraction (1 − η_gt) of the fuel heat; η_cc = η_gt + η_st(1 − η_gt).

cycles.cogeneration.title: Cogeneration utilization factor
assumptions: Utilization factor counts both the net work and the useful heat against the fuel input; it can approach 1 but is not the thermal efficiency.

cycles.vapor_compression.title: Vapour-compression refrigeration: capacity, COP and compressor power

procedure.python:
def _vapor_compression(values):
    """Single-stage vapour-compression refrigeration cycle.

    States: 1 saturated vapour at the evaporator, 2 compressor outlet (isentropic to P_cond), 3 saturated
    liquid at the condenser, 4 throttled to the evaporator (h4 = h3). Refrigeration effect per kg is
    q_L = h1 − h4; compressor work per kg is w_c = h2s − h1 (ideal). With the mass-flow rate m_dot the
    capacity is Q_dot = m_dot q_L and the compressor power W_dot = m_dot w_c; COP = q_L / w_c.
    """
    fluid = values['fluid']
    P_evap, P_cond, m_dot = values['P_evap'], values['P_cond'], values['m_dot']
    if not P_cond > P_evap:
        raise MechError('P_cond must exceed P_evap')
    s = _vc_states(fluid, P_evap, P_cond)
    q_L = s['h1'] - s['h4']
    w_c = s['h2s'] - s['h1']
    if w_c <= 0.0:
        raise MechError('compressor work is not positive; check the pressure levels')
    return {'h1': s['h1'], 'h2': s['h2s'], 'h3': s['h3'], 'h4': s['h4'],
            'T_evap': s['sat_e']['T'], 'T_cond': s['sat_c']['T'],
            'q_L': q_L, 'w_c': w_c, 'cop': q_L / w_c,
            'Q_dot': m_dot * q_L, 'W_dot': m_dot * w_c}

assumptions: Ideal cycle: isentropic compressor, isenthalpic throttling, saturated vapour at the compressor inlet and saturated liquid at the condenser outlet. Refrigerant states from CoolProp.

cycles.cascade_refrigeration.title: Two-stage cascade refrigeration cycle

variables.name: q_L
variables.desc: refrigeration effect per kg low-stage refrigerant

variables.name: w_total
variables.desc: total work per kg low-stage refrigerant

procedure.python:
def _cascade(values):
    """Two-stage cascade refrigeration cycle (one working fluid in both stages).

    Low stage evaporates at P_evap and condenses at P_cascade; high stage evaporates at P_cascade and
    condenses at P_cond. The cascade exchanger balances heat: ṁ_high / ṁ_low = (h2 − h3)_low / (h1 − h4)_high.
    COP and specific heats/works are per unit mass of low-stage refrigerant.
    """
    fluid = values['fluid']
    P_evap, P_cascade, P_cond = values['P_evap'], values['P_cascade'], values['P_cond']
    if not P_cond > P_cascade > P_evap:
        raise MechError('need P_cond > P_cascade > P_evap')
    lo = _vc_states(fluid, P_evap, P_cascade)
    hi = _vc_states(fluid, P_cascade, P_cond)
    q_L = lo['h1'] - lo['h4']                      # refrigeration effect per kg low-stage
    w_low = lo['h2s'] - lo['h1']
    w_high = hi['h2s'] - hi['h1']
    m_ratio = (lo['h2s'] - lo['h3']) / (hi['h1'] - hi['h4'])   # ṁ_high / ṁ_low
    w_total = w_low + m_ratio * w_high
    if w_total <= 0.0:
        raise MechError('cascade work is not positive; check the pressure levels')
    return {'q_L': q_L, 'w_low': w_low, 'w_high': w_high, 'm_ratio': m_ratio,
            'w_total': w_total, 'cop': q_L / w_total,
            'T_evap': lo['sat_e']['T'], 'T_cascade': lo['sat_c']['T'], 'T_cond': hi['sat_c']['T']}

assumptions: Two ideal vapour-compression stages in series sharing one working fluid; the cascade exchanger balances the low-stage condenser load with the high-stage evaporator load. Different fluids per stage are not modelled here.

cycles.multistage_refrigeration.title: Two-stage vapour-compression refrigeration with a flash chamber

variables.name: m3
variables.desc: flash-vapour mass per unit mass through the evaporator

variables.name: q_L
variables.desc: refrigeration effect per kg through evaporator

procedure.python:
def _multistage(values):
    """Two-stage vapour-compression with a flash chamber (multistage refrigeration).

    1 sat. vapour at P_evap → 2 isentropic compression to P_int; the condenser liquid (5, sat. liquid at
    P_cond) is throttled to P_int (state 6, quality x6) and separated in the flash chamber into sat.
    vapour (3) and sat. liquid (7 → evaporator). Vapour flows mix (m1 h2 + m3 h3 = m2 h8) before the
    second-stage compression 8 → 9 to P_cond. COP and works are per unit mass through the evaporator.
    """
    fluid = values['fluid']
    P_evap, P_int, P_cond = values['P_evap'], values['P_int'], values['P_cond']
    if not P_cond > P_int > P_evap:
        raise MechError('need P_cond > P_int > P_evap')
    sat_e = common.saturation(fluid, P=P_evap)
    sat_i = common.saturation(fluid, P=P_int)
    sat_c = common.saturation(fluid, P=P_cond)
    h1, s1 = sat_e['vapour']['h'], sat_e['vapour']['s']
    h3 = sat_i['vapour']['h']
    h7 = sat_i['liquid']['h']
    h5 = sat_c['liquid']['h']
    h2 = common.fluid_state(fluid, P=P_int, s=s1)['h']      # stage 1 outlet
    h6 = h5                                                  # throttle 5 -> 6 (h constant)
    hg_i, hf_i = sat_i['vapour']['h'], sat_i['liquid']['h']
    x6 = (h6 - hf_i) / (hg_i - hf_i)                        # quality after throttle
    # per kg through evaporator: m3/m1 = x6/(1−x6)
    m3 = x6 / (1.0 - x6)
    h8 = (h2 + m3 * h3) / (1.0 + m3)                        # mixed stream into stage 2
    h9 = common.fluid_state(fluid, P=P_cond, s=common.fluid_state(fluid, P=P_int, h=h8)['s'])['h']
    q_L = h1 - h7
    w_c1 = h2 - h1
    w_c2 = (1.0 + m3) * (h9 - h8)                           # per kg through evaporator
    w_total = w_c1 + w_c2
    cop = q_L / w_total
    return {'x6': x6, 'm3': m3, 'h1': h1, 'h2': h2, 'h8': h8, 'h9': h9,
            'q_L': q_L, 'w_c1': w_c1, 'w_c2': w_c2, 'w_total': w_total, 'cop': cop,
            'T_evap': sat_e['T'], 'T_int': sat_i['T'], 'T_cond': sat_c['T']}

assumptions: Ideal isentropic compressors and isenthalpic throttles; the flash chamber separates the throttled condenser liquid into saturated vapour (to the second stage) and saturated liquid (to the evaporator).

cycles.gas_refrigeration.title: Gas (reversed-Brayton) refrigeration cycle COP
assumptions: Air-standard reversed Brayton cycle: isentropic compressor/turbine and constant-pressure heat exchange, so COP = 1/(rp^((γ−1)/γ) − 1).

source.derivation: Inverting MEP = (q_in − cv(T4−T1))/(v1−v2) with T4 = (T1 r^(γ−1) + q_in/cv)/r^(γ−1): solving for q_in gives q_in = 750 kJ/kg
Matched nozzle, V_e < V_in (thrust reverser): F = 50(200−250) + 0 = −2500 N = −2.5 kN (signed thrust)
